headline: Climbing legs showing — now the long day has to land
body:
That 15 miles with 1,003 feet is your steepest ride per mile this season, and it's the right kind of work: roughly 67 feet of climbing per mile, Gibraltar-flavored. But it's also your only ride in eight days, and the week sits at 15 miles. On distance you're short — 27.7 miles is the season's longest against a 62-mile route. On climbing you're shorter still: 1,819 feet in a day versus 6,600 on the day, with 2,551 of it in one 6.1-mile push after 30+ miles.

Eight days out, fitness is what it is. The highest-value thing left is one long ride with real elevation, then rest. Saturday is the day — 73°F, 10 mph with 16 gusts, 10% rain. Sunday is a backup at 26% rain and 14 mph wind. Monday's 76% rain is rest. Tuesday, calm and 70, take a foothill climb at steady effort. Wednesday and Thursday: short, easy spins only.
